explanation: Matches the even case of Conjecture 1.6 in Cho–Choi–Park (arXiv 2107.00295): for isolate-free G with even maximum degree D >= 1, i(G) <= (D^2+4)/(D+2)^2 |V(G)|, cleared of denominators. `0 < G.minDegree` is isolate-free and rules out the empty graph and D = 0. `indepDominationNumber` is the minimum size of an independent dominating set, which exists in any finite graph, so the `sInf` is a true minimum. It also agrees with Cho–Kim–Kim–Oum (arXiv 2202.09594) Corollary 1.3, since 1 - D/floor((D+2)^2/4) = (D^2+4)/(D+2)^2 for even D, so the `research solved` tag is supported. Faithful.
